gap.title: Award level outlay reporting covers under one per cent of obligations
gap.note: THE AUDIT FINDING VISIBLE IN PUBLIC DATA. Outlay reporting covers 0.80 per cent of 9,097.9M obligated and 2114 reports zero. This is the Fund Balance with Treasury weakness appearing in the public record rather than in an audit report. Standing consequence until closed: no cost product may take outlays for this hull from the public spending record.
